name: 🎃 Studlands
desc:
⚠️ PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: Game contains flashing lights and screenshake.

Studlands is an open-world RPG.

Collect loot, craft gear, fight bosses, and level up skills such as fishing and foraging.

🛠️ The game is in beta. Expect big changes, and the occasional chaos.
❌ Any form of cheating or exploiting is prohibited and will result in a permanent ban.
